programme.teaching_language: English (English-taught version of Informatika; the Czech version requires Czech B2)

english.quote: IELTS score 5.5 and above, or BEC 2 – Business English Certificate 2, or STANAG 6001 – level 2, or TOEFL paper-based test score 513 and above, or f. TOEFL CB score 183 and above, or TOEFL iBT score 65 and above
english.notes: English-taught version (fit.cvut.cz/en). List 'not limited to'; no per-band minimum. Page is for the 2026 intake (26/27).

value.description: No grade threshold; admission by FIT CTU Mathematics test or SCIO online test (NSZ).

gpa.quote: Pass the Mathematics test organized at FIT CTU
gpa.notes: Option 1 FIT maths test (90 min, multiple choice), option 2 SCIO online test.

deadline.notes: Only the 2026 cycle is published (2026/27 intake).

tuition.quote: To complete the admission process, you must pay the tuition fee, CZK 64,000 (approx. EUR 2,627 / USD 2,867), for the first semester of your studies.
tuition.notes: Per semester, 2026 intake; ticket 02 Q4 (per-semester convention) pending.

scholarship_exists.notes: No FIT/CTU-wide scholarship for incoming self-paying bachelor students found on cvut.cz; faculty-level merit awards exist elsewhere (FSV) — not this programme.
